notes.title: Series timeline
notes.content:
1951: A dispute breaks out on an island between Maxell and Willsword.
1955: Willsword wins the conflict. Urkafi is founded on the island and becomes an ally of Willsword.
2005: Urkafi becomes the Principality of Lidolphi.
2030: Development of quantum radar neutralizes stealth fighters.
2040: It turns out that AI in unmanned combat aircraft can't beat manned aircraft.
2054: Maxell invades Lidolphi territory. There will be a conflict.
2055: A prototype of an ultra-short-range laser interception system is completed.
2056: The UN issues a statement of condemnation. UN troops are called in and the conflict ends.
2058: Maxell and Willsword conflict. (Gunship Recon)
2059: Willsword develops XF-97 prototype.
2060: A coup d'etat breaks out in Maxell. (Air Combat XF)
2060: XF -98 development is complete.
2062: Maxell invades Willsword (SkyGameChanger - Air Combat II -)
2063: A peace treaty is concluded with the intervention of the United Nations.
2067: Maxell invades Willsword again (Massive Air Combat)
2068: Development of the XF -99 is complete.
2069: Development of the XF-01 (mass-produced XF) was completed.
2072: The war ended with Willsword's victory.
2074: MF -100, a mass-produced version of the XF, is supplied to the Duchy of Lidolphi. (Air Combat MF)
2075: Within Maxell, the Eastern Laurasia becomes independent and a conflict erupts. (AA Soldiers)
2385: Conflict between the two countries occurs in outer space.(Space Battle SVF)

notes.title: After a year of updates
notes.content:
This game is the main content of Sonic-Alpha, and to some extent did what the producer wanted to express in terms of numerous fighters and war direction.
The downside is that there is still no save and load functionality, and the story and mission are poorly explained in the game.
However, the following changes were made in the one-year update:
In its first release, it was just a nine-level arcade game. The language was English only.
There are now 16 levels of main game, 3 levels of DLC, 4 levels of DLC fighting game, DLC puzzle games, 14 tracks of free music and a PDF manual. It now supports 20 languages.

Thanks to the all players who invested in this game in the first release.

notes.title: Assistant
notes.content:
She is an assistant to the player. She volunteered for the army to change her weak character. She looks young, but she is 27 years old. She is in charge of a wide range of tasks, including taking care of player and guarding him.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34616520/f691c0f7c6f3ba9b15d2f26908667f28536d344f.png[/img]

notes.title: XF-99 Joint Strike Fighter
notes.content:
When the XF -99's MD armor detects an enemy missile, it fires the EMP to disable the enemy missile's electronics. Once the electronics are disabled, high-power lasers weaken enemy missiles' speed.
The pilot on the XF -99 received the Medal of Honor and public praise as a national hero, but disappeared somewhere after the war.
After the war, powerful fighters such as the XF -99 were no longer needed, and they were stored under tight security.

notes.title: Information about the leaderboard
notes.content:
After finishing the score ranking level, if you start the score ranking level again without ending the game, it was discovered that the score was added to the previous score.
However, since there are players who have challenged the level multiple times and gained a high score, I would like to change this ranking to "How many enemies have been defeated" without modifying the game.
With "Air-Combat" and "SkyGameChanger-AirCombatII-", the score is properly reset to zero.

I'm sorry, but thank you for your understanding.
